item.title: How to Reason About CUDA Streams and Block Admission
item.description: First-principles walkthrough of CUDA streams, the driver's channels and GPFIFOs, and block admission onto SMs, followed by an instrumented two-stream experiment on an NVIDIA B200 with per-block timelines you can explore in the page or in Perfetto.
